responsibility: This header provides the user-facing compatibility layer for writing eBPF C programs with GCC in the style of Linux’s llvm-oriented bpf_helpers.h. It defines the SEC and kernel_helper attributes, common helper flags and map-definition structures, and declares a large table of BPF helper function prototypes annotated with helper numbers so front ends can type-check calls and the BPF backend can recognize them as kernel helper invocations rather than normal functions; it also exposes load_byte/load_half/load_word aliases for GCC’s BPF builtins.
